def wcols(fr):
    L=fr.ascii.split('\n')

    cs=sorted(set(c for r,c in W))
    return (min(cs),max(cs)) if W else None

def gl(fr): return {f"S{i}":g(fr,41,15+7*i) for i in range(5)}|{f"P{i}":g(fr,52,15+7*i) for i in range(5)}
gb,ga=gl(before),gl(after)
changed=[k for k in gb if gb[k]!=ga[k]]
print("bracket before:",wcols(before),"after:",wcols(after))
print("glyphs changed:",changed)
# show P1 before/after

    print(k,"before:"); [print(''.join('#' if x else '.' for x in row)) for row in gb[k]]

res=action(['LEFT'])

def wcols(fr):
    L=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    W=[(r,c) for r in range(46,62) for c in range(10,50) if L[r][c]=='W']
    cs=sorted(set(c for r,c in W))
    return (min(cs),max(cs)) if W else None

def gl(fr): return {f"S{i}":g(fr,41,15+7*i) for i in range(5)}|{f"P{i}":g(fr,52,15+7*i) for i in range(5)}
gb,ga=gl(before),gl(after)

    print(k,"before:"); [print(''.join('#' if x else '.' for x in row)) for row in gb[k]]
